name: 85629 · Sahuarita, AZ
findings: ZIP 85629 (Sahuarita) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85629 (Sahuarita) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
55% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85629 (Sahuarita) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 32% of the typical level).
